newsitem.title: USA: U.S West Coast crudes lose ground, Wilmington sold.
newsitem.headline: U.S West Coast crudes lose ground, Wilmington sold.

text.p: Prices for U.S. West Coast light crude lost ground with West Texas Intermediate (WTI) late on Tuesday, but premiums for California Wilmington crude rose after a parcel sold early.
Ultramar Corp said on Tuesday it planned to shut several hydroprocessing units at their Wilmington refinery to conduct repairs and ease the cost of falling margins.
A Northwest refinery cut November crude runs by 18 percent on Monday, and several others considered reduced production.
Meanwhile, ANS sellers kept offers $2.10 below November WTI, compared to bids of minus $2.50.
